adminRest.reason: Liveness probe, no sign-in. /api/health is answered by services/admin/src/index.ts before the sign-in middleware (the config router's own GET /health under /api is never reached behind it); nginx serves it as /admin/api/health to internal networks only (the Docker and Kubernetes health checks) and denies every other source.

Cockpit sign-out: the shell (services/admin/app/shell/webapp/controller/App.controller.ts) posts to /admin/logout, which nginx rewrites to /api/logout. It answers where the browser goes next (the oauth2-proxy sign-out URL or the configured logout page); it is part of the cockpit's sign-in flow, not an API for other clients.

The cockpit's notification stream (Server-Sent Events): the shell (services/admin/app/shell/webapp/controller/App.controller.ts) opens /admin/api/notifications/stream, an nginx location of its own without buffering. It pushes events to the open cockpit; it is not a request and response API.

The API reference page itself (Swagger UI), a static subtree mounted at /api/docs in src/index.ts behind the sign-in: the page, its init script, the Swagger UI files and the four OpenAPI documents. It is the viewer of this document, not an API a client calls, so it is not described in it.
